findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "http" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mailbox_send, mailbox_check, mailbox_stream, webhook_register, webhook_verify · Private data: register, renew_agent_key, webhook_register, webhook_verify · Public sink: register, mailbox_send, mailbox_check, mailbox_claim, mailbox_ack, renew_agent_key, webhook_register, webhook_verify, webhook_delete · Destructive: mailbox_claim, webhook_verify, webhook_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mailbox_send, mailbox_check, mailbox_stream, webhook_register, webhook_verify · Private data: register, renew_agent_key, webhook_register, webhook_verify · Public sink: register, mailbox_send, mailbox_check, mailbox_claim, mailbox_ack, renew_agent_key, webhook_register, webhook_verify, webhook_delete · Destructive: mailbox_claim, webhook_verify, webhook_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
